name: report
description: 全流程重型研报：18 Agent 闭环交付 (含欺诈检测、三市场适配、双HITL、独立QA)
prompt: 针对 {{target}} 执行全流程重型研报 (v1.2.0, 18-agent)。orchestrator 按 task_type→tier 硬路由并维护 pipeline-state.json。流程: 0. screen (ticker-resolver消歧 + filing-collector采集到raw/)；1. financial-researcher 解析到extracted/ + evidence-locker 登记FN；2. black-account-checker 跑流水六步法 + M-Score/Z-Score/Sloan/现金债悖论 + 治理红旗；3. financial-analyst 多文档对账，gate-keeper 收 Pre-Valuation HITL (analyst_gate=APPROVED 后继续)；4. industry-peer-analyst peer交叉 + macro归因 + ESG筛查，sentiment-event-analyst 输出事件日历 (旁路不阻塞)；5. valuation-expert DCF定价 + scenario-sensitivity-analyst 三情景敏感性 + visualization-excel 活表图表；6. portfolio-strategist 仓位建议；7. adversarial-skeptic 红队 + compliance-checker 措辞审 + judge-qa 三方比对 (异构模型)，gate-keeper 收 Pre-Publication (SIGNED_OFF 后放行)；8. report-writer 出 FN 合规研报到 workspace/reports/ (含 Challenge Resolution Summary + disclaimer)。T1 失败 cascade 到 T2；缺一不可。
